sources.entry: Earnote - Records lectures, meetings and calls, transcribes them locally with Whisper and writes structured notes with an on-device AI model.

summary.one_liner: Earnote is a free, open-source native macOS app that records meetings, calls and lectures, transcribes them locally, and writes structured AI notes into Notion, Obsidian, Apple Notes and other targets.
summary.what_it_does: Captures microphone and system audio (Core Audio process taps, no virtual audio device) and detects when Zoom, Teams, Webex, FaceTime, Slack or a browser call starts, offering to record. Transcription runs locally with Apple Speech (macOS 26+) or Whisper via WhisperKit, with "Me" / "Others" speaker labels. Notes are generated by a built-in on-device model by default, or by Apple Intelligence, Ollama, LM Studio, or cloud providers such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Mistral, and any OpenAI-compatible server. Output goes to Notion, Obsidian, Logseq, Apple Notes, a Markdown folder, Bear or Craft, and open tasks go to Reminders, Things or Todoist. Extras include long-recording chunking, a playback bar with timestamp jumping, transcript search, flashcards with CSV export for Anki, PDF export, and a semester overview across lectures. An iPhone version is described as in TestFlight beta.
use_cases: take AI meeting notes without a monthly subscription
transcribe Zoom, Teams or Meet calls on a Mac
export meeting notes to Obsidian or Notion
turn action items into Apple Reminders or Todoist tasks
transcribe an existing audio file offline
how_to_run: brew tap louiskl/earnote && brew trust louiskl/earnote && brew install --cask earnote
Alternatively, download Earnote.dmg from Releases and drag Earnote into Applications
Build from source: install Xcode 26 from the App Store
Open Earnote.xcodeproj in Xcode (packages WhisperKit and MLX resolve automatically) and press ⌘R
notable: Fully local pipeline by default: transcription and a built-in on-device language model, so audio and transcripts stay on the Mac
No BlackHole or virtual audio driver needed to capture other participants' audio
Call detection pop-up that can also stop recording when the call ends
Flashcards generated inside the note and exportable as CSV for Anki
Handles 3+ hour recordings by chunked audio processing and map-reduce summarization
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or newer); Intel Macs are not supported
Needs about 2.3 GB free space for the local model and 8 GB RAM or more; Apple Speech and Apple Intelligence require macOS 26
Marked as beta (1.0.1); the iPhone app is in TestFlight testing with the App Store release planned later
